title: Recognize Windows Native Extension Binaries in Scientific Provenance
body:
The canonical source snapshot searches only .so binaries, so an installed PyO3 module with a Windows .pyd extension would fail native provenance discovery before CLI/GUI execution.

## Acceptance Criteria

Recognize native Python extension layouts for direct and packaged .so/.pyd modules through one shared helper. Continue requiring exactly one native binary with an actual file hash. Add red–green tests for both extension layouts and ambiguous/missing binaries. Do not claim real Windows flight validation from path-discovery unit tests.

## Validation

Independent inspection found the .so-only suffix/glob. Focused cross-platform filename tests plus real Linux CLI/native regressions required.

## Handoff

Branch `codex/shot-pattern-analysis`; all saved experiment/native archive bytes remain unchanged. Keep open until merged implementing PR.
